Oh, what a charming portrait—five young friends sitting beneath our courtyard shade tree!

lines.trans: There is my aunt pouring tea beside the open shutters of Room Nine!
And on the left with a violin under his chin sits number ten!

Who are the other two smiling neighbours holding plates of cake at table one?
Look at the tiny caption pencilled along the lower margin of the sketch, Mazen.
Friday Tea Crew, May: five chairs today, twenty-four chairs when we meet again!
They dreamed of twenty-four chairs around these stones thirty summers before you ordered them!
Do you hear that, Suad?! My accidental chair order fulfilled a thirty-year prophecy!
Let us frame this charcoal sketch right above the walnut piano, Mazen.

meanings.note: The number four, used with masculine nouns.

examples.trans: I bought four books.
The guests arrived at four in the afternoon.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for seeing a group of people.

examples.trans: I will see you tomorrow at school.

examples.text: يلا مع السلامة، أشوفكم الأسبوع الجاي إن شاء الله.
examples.trans: Alright, goodbye—see you all next week, God willing.

meanings.note: Plural of صديق (ṣadīq). In Jordanian, صحاب (ṣḥāb) is more common.

examples.trans: These are childhood friends.

examples.text: صرنا أصدقاء مقربين من أول سنة بالجامعة.
examples.trans: We became close friends from our very first year at university.

meanings.note: Name of the month of May in the Levantine calendar.

examples.trans: My birthday is in the month of May.

examples.text: الطقس بشهر أيار بكون دافي ومناسب للرحلات.
examples.trans: The weather in May is warm and ideal for trips.

meanings.note: Second person masculine singular pronoun.

examples.trans: Where do you live?

examples.text: إنت اللي رسمت الخريطة هاي بإيدك؟
examples.trans: Are you the one who drew this map by hand?

meanings.note: Command to a male to wait.

examples.trans: Wait just a minute.

examples.text: استنى شوي، أنا نازل معك هسه!
examples.trans: Wait a second—I'm coming down with you right now!

meanings.note: Command to open.

examples.trans: Open the door quickly.

examples.text: افتح الشباك شوي عشان يتهوّى المكتب.
examples.trans: Open the window a little so the office airs out.

meanings.note: Feminine definite form of original, used for things that are authentic.

examples.text: هاي هي القطعة الأصلية مش تقليد.
examples.trans: This is the original piece, not a fake.

examples.text: النسخة الأصلية من العقد محفوظة بالملف الأزرق.
examples.trans: The original copy of the contract is kept in the blue folder.

meanings.note: Refers to the day of the week (Monday) or the number two.

examples.trans: I will see you next Monday.

examples.text: اجتماعنا الجاي رح يكون يوم الاثنين الصبح.
examples.trans: Our next meeting will be on Monday morning.

meanings.note: Navigation tool, sometimes used metaphorically for guidance.

examples.trans: They got lost in the desert because they forgot the compass.

examples.text: البوصلة القديمة بتشير دايماً لجهة الشمال.
examples.trans: The old compass always points toward the north.

meanings.note: Commonly means a comment on social media or sports commentary.

examples.text: قرأت التعليق اللي كتبته على الفيسبوك.
examples.trans: I read the comment you wrote on Facebook.

examples.text: شكراً على التعليق اللطيف اللي كتبته تحت الصورة.
examples.trans: Thanks for the kind comment you wrote under the photo.

meanings.note: Plural referring to other people or items in a group.

examples.trans: Where are the other guys?

examples.text: أصحابي الثانيين وصلوا القهوة قبلنا بنص ساعة.
examples.trans: My other friends got to the cafe half an hour before us.

meanings.note: The holy day in Islam and the weekend in Jordan.

examples.trans: On Friday, the whole family gathers.

examples.text: بنزور ستي كل يوم الجمعة بعد صلاة الظهر.
examples.trans: We visit my grandmother every Friday after the noon prayer.

الجوز.gloss: the walnuts / the husband / the pair

meanings.en: the walnuts / the husband / the pair
meanings.note: Depending on context, it means walnuts, a husband (from zoj), or a pair.

examples.trans: I put some walnuts on the cake.

examples.text: أمي بتحشي المعمول بالتمر أو الجوز في العيد.
examples.trans: My mom stuffs the maamoul pastries with dates or walnuts for Eid.

meanings.note: Plural for neighbors. Highly important in Jordanian culture.

examples.trans: The neighbors invited us for lunch.

examples.text: سلمت على الجيران الجداد اللي سكنوا بالطابق التالت.
examples.trans: I greeted the new neighbors who moved into the third floor.

meanings.note: Another plural form for stone, slightly more formal than 'hjaar'.

examples.trans: The house is built from old stones.

examples.text: البيوت في وسط البلد مبنية من الحجارة الصفرا.
examples.trans: The houses in downtown are built out of yellow limestone.

الحلو.gloss: the sweet / the beautiful / the dessert

meanings.en: the sweet / the beautiful / the dessert
meanings.note: Can refer to a handsome person, something nice, or sweet desserts.

examples.text: جاب معاه بوكس الحلو بعد الشغل.
examples.trans: He brought a box of dessert with him after work.

examples.text: وزعنا الحلو على المعازيم بنهاية الحفلة.
examples.trans: We handed out the sweets to the guests at the end of the party.

meanings.note: Colloquial plural for 'khareeta' (map).

examples.trans: We used the maps to find the way.

examples.text: فتحت الخرايط على التلفون عشان أشوف الأزمة وين.
examples.trans: I opened the maps on my phone to see where the traffic jam is.

meanings.note: A specific piece of artwork or a sketch.

examples.trans: The drawing you drew is very beautiful.

examples.text: بنتي علقت الرسمة تبعتها على باب التلاجة.
examples.trans: My daughter hung her drawing up on the fridge door.

meanings.note: Used to describe something at the bottom.

examples.trans: The lower floor is cold.

examples.text: خزنا المونة بالرف السفلي عشان يضل بارد.
examples.trans: We stored the pantry provisions on the bottom shelf so they stay cool.

meanings.note: Means either left direction or the geographical north.

examples.trans: Turn to the left.

examples.text: إربد وعجلون موجودات في منطقة الشمال بالأردن.
examples.trans: Irbid and Ajloun are located in the northern region of Jordan.

meanings.note: Used for small objects or young people.

examples.trans: My little brother is studying.

examples.text: الولد الصغير ركض ورا الكرة بالملعب.
examples.trans: The little boy chased after the ball on the field.

meanings.note: Very common for a dent in a car or a bent piece of metal.

examples.trans: There is a dent in the car.

examples.text: البودي فيه شوية شغل عشان نصلح الطعجة بالباب.
examples.trans: The bodywork needs a bit of fixing to take out the dent in the door.

meanings.note: Used for shade from the sun.

examples.trans: Let's sit in the shade.

examples.text: صفينا السيارة تحت الشجرة عشان تضل في الظل.
examples.trans: We parked the car under the tree so it would stay in the shade.

meanings.note: Used primarily for grilling or for water pipes (argileh).

examples.trans: Light the charcoal so we can grill.

examples.text: شغلنا الفحم على البلكونة عشان نعمل مشاوي.
examples.trans: We lit the charcoal on the balcony to make grilled meats.

meanings.note: Used for old objects, not usually people.

examples.trans: The old phone broke.

examples.text: جدي لسه محتفظ بالراديو القديم بغرفته.
examples.trans: My grandfather still keeps the old radio in his room.

meanings.note: Used almost exclusively to mean aluminum foil in the kitchen.

examples.trans: Wrap the food in tin foil.

examples.text: غطيت صينية الدجاج بالقصدير قبل ما أدخلها الفرن.
examples.trans: I covered the chicken tray with aluminum foil before putting it in the oven.

meanings.note: Plural of chair.

examples.trans: Bring the chairs for the guests.

examples.text: صفينا الكراسي بالحديقة عشان عزومة بكرا.
examples.trans: We lined up the chairs in the garden for tomorrow's gathering.

meanings.note: The universal relative pronoun in Levantine Arabic.

examples.trans: The man who I saw yesterday.

examples.text: هذا المحل اللي اشترينا منه الكنافة الأسبوع الماضي.
examples.trans: This is the shop where we bought the kunafa last week.

meanings.note: Everyday word for facial tissues or handkerchiefs.

examples.trans: Give me the box of tissues.

examples.text: ناولتني اختي ورقة من علبة المحارم اللي عالطاولة.
examples.trans: My sister handed me a tissue from the tissue box on the table.

meanings.note: Open (feminine).

examples.trans: The open room lets air in.

examples.text: سكر الشبابيك المفتوحة قبل ما نطلع من البيت.
examples.trans: Close the open windows before we leave the house.

meanings.note: Can mean a written thing or commonly a physical letter.

examples.trans: I received the letter from my friend.

examples.text: زمان كان المرسال يوصل المكتوب على البسكليت.
examples.trans: In the old days the mail carrier used to deliver the letter by bicycle.

meanings.note: Made of copper (feminine).

examples.trans: The copper pot makes delicious coffee.

examples.text: مسكت اليد النحاسية للباب اللي برن جرسها قديم.
examples.trans: I grabbed the brass doorknob whose bell sounds vintage.

meanings.note: Margin of a page or margin of a society.

examples.trans: Write your notes on the margin.

examples.text: الدكتور كتب تعليقه على الهامش بقلم أحمر.
examples.trans: The professor wrote his comment in the margin with a red pen.

meanings.note: A single piece of paper or leaf.

examples.trans: Write your name on this piece of paper.

examples.text: وقع الموظف على الورقة وختمها بالختم الرسمي.
examples.trans: The clerk signed the sheet of paper and stamped it with the official seal.

meanings.note: Today (literally: the day).

examples.trans: Today the weather is very nice.

examples.text: اليوم عنا شغل كتير بالمكتب وما رح نروح بدري.
examples.trans: Today we have a lot of work at the office and won't head home early.

meanings.note: By or with four, or for four (e.g. in currency).

examples.trans: I bought this item for four dinars.
We finished decorating the trays in four colours.

meanings.note: Exactly, precisely.

examples.text: هذا اللي كنت بدي أحكيه بالضبط.
examples.trans: This is exactly what I wanted to say.
We arrived at nine o'clock sharp.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian expression for doing something accidentally.

examples.trans: I called you by mistake.
He ate a hot chili pepper by mistake!

meanings.note: Used mostly when referring to grilling or making tea on charcoal.

examples.trans: We made tea on charcoal.
He drew the lines on the paper with black charcoal.

meanings.note: Commonly used for pouring liquids like water, coffee, or tea.

examples.trans: Can you pour me a glass of water?

examples.text: سلمى بتصب العسل الدافي فوق اللوز المحمص.
examples.trans: Salma pours the warm honey over the toasted almonds.

meanings.note: Refers to an outdoor area belonging to a home or building owned by the speakers.

examples.trans: We planted a tree in our courtyard.
There is a large lemon tree in our courtyard.

meanings.note: Refers to the lowest part of a container, the sea, or any deep object.

examples.trans: The key fell at the bottom of the pool.

examples.text: ضل شوية سكر بقاع كاسة الشاي.
examples.trans: A little sugar stayed at the bottom of the teacup.

meanings.note: Used to indicate authorship or the instrument used.

examples.trans: This article is by a famous writer.

examples.text: سلمى سجلت النتايج بقلم رصاص ناعم.
examples.trans: Salma recorded the results with a soft pencil.

meanings.note: The musical instrument.

examples.trans: He plays the piano every day.
The black piano is placed in the corner of the parlour.

meanings.note: Describes a group of people laughing.

examples.trans: The boys are laughing loudly.
The children are laughing as they look for the treasure.

meanings.note: Used to indicate first-person possession.

examples.trans: This book is mine, not yours.
My notebook is still open on the table.

meanings.note: Indicates physical location beneath something.

examples.trans: The cat is hiding under the table.

examples.text: لقينا البطاقة التانية تحت الصحن الأبيض.
examples.trans: We found the second card under the white plate.

meanings.note: The number 9.

examples.trans: I have nine books on the shelf.

examples.text: الساعة تسعة الصبح رح نلتقي عند النافورة.
examples.trans: At nine in the morning we will meet by the fountain.

meanings.note: Used to say stay, remain, or keep doing something.

examples.trans: You must stay here and not move.

examples.text: حطينا العلبة بالظل عشان تضل المكونات باردة.
examples.trans: We put the tin in the shade so the ingredients stay cool.

meanings.note: A unit of time or the feminine ordinal for second.

examples.trans: Wait for me just one second.

examples.text: كل ثانية بالسباق مهمة كتير للفريق.
examples.trans: Every second in the race matters a lot to the team.

meanings.note: The number 30 with the "th" sound preserved.

examples.trans: He paid thirty dinars for the ticket.

examples.text: الدفتر مكتوب قبل ثلاثين سنة تقريبا.
examples.trans: The notebook was written roughly thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Commonly used preposition for indicating proximity, next to, or beside.

examples.trans: Sit next to your brother.
We set the trays next to the fountain in the shade.

meanings.note: Form II verb in the past tense. Can mean 'she achieved' or 'I achieved' depending on the vowel.

examples.trans: She finally achieved her dream.

examples.text: سلمى حققت حلمها وفتحت مخبز العسل.
examples.trans: Salma achieved her dream and opened the honey bakery.

meanings.note: Past tense verb indicating dreaming, for a third-person plural subject.

examples.trans: They dreamt of a better future.

examples.text: الأولاد حلموا يلاقوا الكنز قبل نهاية اليوم.
examples.trans: The children dreamed of finding the treasure before the day ended.

meanings.note: A very common preposition denoting physical surrounding or approximation of time/quantity.

examples.trans: There are many people around the roundabout.

examples.text: جمعنا الكراسي حوالين الطاولة الكبيرة بالساحة.
examples.trans: We gathered the chairs around the big table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Plural of 'khatt', referring to lines, phone numbers, or routes.

examples.trans: There are red lines in the matter.

examples.text: الخطوط اللي عالخريطة بتدل على البوابات.
examples.trans: The lines on the map point toward the gates.

meanings.note: Extremely common phrase used to suggest doing something together, like 'let's...'.

examples.trans: Let's go out to eat dinner outside.

examples.text: خلينا نقرأ البطاقة الأخيرة قبل ما نحكم.
examples.trans: Let us read the last card before we judge.

meanings.note: The number five, typically used before feminine counted nouns.

examples.trans: There are five minutes left and we will arrive.

examples.text: ضفت خمس معالق زبدة دايبة للعجين.
examples.trans: I added five spoonfuls of melted butter to the batter.

meanings.note: Common everyday word for a medical doctor or a PhD holder.

examples.trans: The doctor examined the patient.

examples.text: الدكتور نصحنا نشرب شاي أعشاب دافي.
examples.trans: The doctor advised us to drink warm herbal tea.

meanings.note: Refers to the chin or beard, with a third person masculine singular possessive suffix.

examples.trans: He grew his beard a lot.

examples.text: حك ذقنه وهو بفكر بطريقة فتح القفل.
examples.trans: He rubbed his chin while thinking of a way to open the lock.

meanings.note: Can mean the metal lead, or bullets. Often used in 'qalam rSaaS' (pencil).

examples.trans: Write with a pencil so you can erase it.

examples.text: الرقم مكتوب بقلم رصاص خفيف جنب الزاوية.
examples.trans: The number is written in light pencil near the corner.

meanings.note: Everyday word for a number, digit, or phone number.

examples.trans: What is your phone number?

examples.text: كل بطاقة إلها رقم متسلسل من واحد لعشرة.
examples.trans: Each card has a serial number from one to ten.

meanings.note: Active participle used as 'I hear' or 'hearing' for a feminine subject.

examples.trans: I hear a strange sound.

examples.text: أنا سامعة صوت طنين نحل قريب من الشباك.
examples.trans: I hear the sound of bees buzzing near the window.

meanings.note: Means peace, safety, and is widely used as a greeting or farewell.

examples.trans: Pass on my greetings to him.

examples.text: سلّم عالجميع وقلهم سلام حار مني.
examples.trans: Greet everyone and give them warm greetings from me.

meanings.note: Everyday word for a year.

examples.trans: This car is this year's model.

examples.text: مرّت سنة كاملة على آخر زيارة للمزرعة.
examples.trans: A whole year has passed since the last visit to the farm.

meanings.note: A staple beverage in Jordanian culture, typically served with mint or sage.

examples.trans: I like to drink tea after lunch.

examples.text: صبينا كاسات شاي ساخن مع ورق النعناع.
examples.trans: We poured glasses of hot tea with mint leaves.

meanings.note: Extremely common word for a young man, guy, or youth.

examples.trans: This young man is very respectful.
A kind young man who works at the library helped us.

meanings.note: Plural of 'shabb'. Often used to address a group of people collectively, like 'guys'.

examples.trans: Come on guys, let's go.

examples.text: يا شباب، تعالوا نبدأ التذوق قبل ما تبرد الكيكة.
examples.trans: Guys, come start the tasting before the cake gets cold.

meanings.note: Plural of 'shubbaak' (window).

examples.trans: Open the windows so the room airs out.

examples.text: فتحنا كل شبابيك المطبخ عشان يدخل هوا بارد.
examples.trans: We opened all the kitchen windows so cool air would come in.

meanings.note: Everyday word for a tree.

examples.trans: We planted an olive tree in the garden.

examples.text: قعدنا تحت شجرة الزيزفون الكبيرة بالساحة.
examples.trans: We sat under the big linden tree in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Colloquial term for a tight-knit group of friends or a clique.

examples.trans: We went out to have dinner with the group of friends.

examples.text: كل الشلة اتجمعت عالبلكونة وقت الغروب.
examples.trans: The whole group of friends gathered on the balcony at sunset.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian interrogative pronoun for 'what'.

examples.trans: What are you doing here?

examples.text: شو المكون السري اللي ضفتيه عالعجينة؟
examples.trans: What is the secret ingredient that you added to the batter?

meanings.note: Imperative verb used when telling a single male to look or see.

examples.trans: Look at the bird on the tree.

examples.text: شوف الرقم المكتوب بقلم الرصاص عالزاوية!
examples.trans: Look at the number written in pencil in the corner!

meanings.note: Plural of ṣaḥn (صحن). Very common in everyday household contexts.

examples.trans: I washed all the dishes after lunch.

examples.text: رتبنا تلات صحون فخار على طاولة التذوق.
examples.trans: We arranged three earthenware plates on the tasting table.

meanings.note: The season of summer.

examples.trans: Summer in Jordan is usually hot.

examples.text: بالصيف بنحب نقعد بالعريشة تحت العنب.
examples.trans: In the summer we like to sit under the grape arbour.

meanings.note: Common everyday word for table.

examples.trans: Put the things on the table.

examples.text: طاولة المطبخ مليانة علب بهارات ومرطبانات.
examples.trans: The kitchen table is full of spice tins and jars.

meanings.note: Past tense verb with a third-person plural object pronoun.

examples.trans: The items I ordered have arrived.

examples.text: الصواني اللي طلبتهم سلمى وصلوا الصبح.
examples.trans: The tins that Salma ordered arrived in the morning.

meanings.note: Noun 'talabiyya' (an order/request) with a first-person possessive pronoun.

examples.trans: When will my order arrive?

examples.text: طلبيتي من العسل الجبلي وصلت مغلفة منيح.
examples.trans: My order of mountain honey arrived well wrapped.

meanings.note: Can refer to physical length, height, or duration of time (e.g., all day).

examples.trans: He stayed asleep all day long.

examples.text: مشينا على طول السور القديم لحد البوابة.
examples.trans: We walked along the length of the old wall up to the gate.

meanings.note: Extremely common colloquial conjunction used to indicate reason or purpose.

examples.trans: I went to the doctor because I am sick.

examples.text: استعملنا ورق نشافة عشان الحبر ما يطبع.
examples.trans: We used blotting paper so the ink would not stain.

meanings.note: The standalone number ten.

examples.trans: The time is ten o'clock right now.
The shop closes at ten o'clock at night.

meanings.note: Can refer to a cardboard box, a tin can, or a small container.

examples.trans: Open the can of tuna.

examples.text: البطاقات مرتبة جوا علبة صفيح مدهونة أزرق.
examples.trans: The cards are arranged inside a tin box painted blue.

meanings.note: Standard preposition for 'on', 'upon', or 'to'.

examples.trans: The book is on the table.

examples.text: حطينا الخريطة على الطاولة وبلشنا نحللها.
examples.trans: We laid the map on the table and began analysing it.

meanings.note: Aunt on the father's side.

examples.trans: My paternal aunt is going to visit us today.

examples.text: عمتي دايما بتحط برش ليمون جوا العجين.
examples.trans: My paternal aunt always puts lemon zest into the batter.

meanings.note: Idiomatically used for 'she has ever' or 'in her life'.

examples.trans: She has never seen snow in her life.

examples.text: عمرها البوابة ما تسكرت بوقت الضهر.
examples.trans: The gate has never been locked at noon.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for a room in a house or building.

examples.trans: The bedroom is very spacious.

examples.text: غرفة المكتبة هادية ومليانة كتب خرائط.
examples.trans: The library room is quiet and full of atlases.

meanings.note: Used as a preposition or adverb meaning 'above', 'over', or 'upstairs'.

examples.trans: The book is on top of the table.

examples.text: الخريطة معلقة فوق الرف الخشبي بالمكتبة.
examples.trans: The map is hanging above the wooden shelf in the library.

meanings.note: Literally 'sitting', but widely used as an auxiliary participle to denote continuous present action (like English '-ing').

examples.trans: I am (currently) studying for the exam.

examples.text: مازن قاعد بقرا التعليمات بصوت عالي عشان الكل يسمع.
examples.trans: Mazen is sitting reading the instructions aloud so everyone can hear.

meanings.note: Plural form of 'قاعد' (gāʕid), used as a continuous action marker for plural subjects.

examples.trans: The boys are playing in the street.

examples.text: إحنا قاعدين بالحديقة بنستنى الكيكة تبرد عالبلكونة.
examples.trans: We are sitting in the garden waiting for the cake to cool on the balcony.

meanings.note: Preposition and adverb for time or sequence meaning 'prior to' or 'before'.

examples.trans: I have to arrive before five o'clock.

examples.text: غسلنا الفواكه منيح قبل ما نقطعها للتذوق.
examples.trans: We washed the fruit thoroughly before slicing it for the tasting.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for soon or near.

examples.trans: I will arrive very soon.

examples.text: سلمى رح ترجع قريب ومعها مرطبان العسل الجبلي.
examples.trans: Salma will be back soon bringing the jar of mountain honey.

meanings.note: Plural of chair (kursī).

examples.trans: We need to buy new chairs for the living room.

examples.text: صفينا خمس كراسي خشب حوالين طاولة الساحة.
examples.trans: We lined up five wooden chairs around the courtyard table.

meanings.note: An everyday item of furniture for sitting.

examples.trans: This chair is not comfortable.

examples.text: جدي قعد على كرسي القش جنب شجرة الليمون.
examples.trans: My grandfather sat on the wicker chair beside the lemon tree.

meanings.note: The musical instrument 'violin' (kamanga) with the 3rd person masculine possessive suffix.

examples.trans: He played his violin skillfully.

examples.text: طالع كمانجته من الصندوق الخشب وعزف لحن هادي.
examples.trans: He took his violin out of the wooden case and played a gentle tune.

meanings.note: Refers generally to cake as a type of food.

examples.trans: I like eating cake with tea.

examples.text: خبزنا كيك بالعسل واللوز وعملنا جنبه شاي نعناع.
examples.trans: We baked honey and almond cake and made mint tea alongside it.

meanings.note: Points to something belonging to, or intended for, a specific illustration or drawing.

examples.trans: I brought new colors for the drawing.

examples.text: زدنا شوية تفاصيل صغيرة للرسمة بالقلم الأسود.
examples.trans: We added a few tiny details to the drawing with the black pen.

meanings.note: Common conjunction used to introduce a time clause, distinct from the question word 'when' (mita).

examples.trans: Call me when you reach home.

examples.text: لما بردت الكيكة صبينا فوقها العسل الدافي.
examples.trans: When the cake cooled, we poured the warm honey over it.

meanings.note: Used mostly as a negative particle for verbs ('didn't') or as a relative pronoun/conjunction ('what' or 'that which').

examples.trans: I haven't eaten anything since the morning.

examples.text: ما عرفت إنه العلبة فيها طابق سري من تحت.
examples.trans: I did not know that the box had a secret compartment underneath.

meanings.note: Active participle indicating the ongoing state of gripping or grasping something.

examples.trans: He is holding the phone all day.

examples.text: طارق ماسك البوصلة بإيده وبتبع الاتجاهات.
examples.trans: Tariq is holding the compass in his hand and following the directions.

meanings.note: 'Marrah' means 'a time/once' (e.g. waḥdeh marrah = one time), but 'mara' (مَرَة) means 'woman/wife' in colloquial Jordanian.

examples.trans: I went to Petra one time.

examples.text: جربنا الوصفة مرة تانية بس بخففنا السكر شوي.
examples.trans: We tried the recipe one more time, though we reduced the sugar slightly.

meanings.note: One of the most basic Arabic prepositions indicating origin.

examples.trans: I am from Jordan.

examples.text: جبنا العسل البلدي الصافي من مزرعة قريبة.
examples.trans: We brought the pure local honey from a nearby farm.

meanings.note: Interrogative pronoun used for people.

examples.trans: Who rang the bell?

examples.text: مين كتب هاي الملاحظة عالورقة بالحبر الأزرق؟
examples.trans: Who wrote this note on the paper in blue ink?

meanings.note: Verb for putting a picture or document in a frame.

examples.trans: We must frame this picture.

examples.text: خلينا نبروز الخريطة القديمة ونعلقها بالمكتبة.
examples.trans: Let us frame the old map and hang it in the library.

meanings.note: Formal word for a prediction of the future, often religious.

examples.trans: The ancient prophecy came true.

examples.text: الكلام المكتوب بالدفتر طلع كأنه نبوءة تحققت اليوم.
examples.trans: The words written in the notebook turned out like a prophecy fulfilled today.

meanings.note: Often used to mean 'the same' when followed by a noun, or as a reflexive.

examples.trans: We live in the same building.

examples.text: استعملنا نفس الوصفة بس زدنا شوية برش برتقال.
examples.trans: We used the exact same recipe, though we added a little orange zest.

meanings.note: Standard first person plural verb often used in colloquial speech.

examples.trans: When will we meet again?

examples.text: خلينا نلتقي بكرا العصر بوسط البلد نشرب قهوة.
examples.trans: Let's meet tomorrow afternoon downtown to have coffee.

meanings.note: Demonstrative attached to a loanword.

examples.trans: This portrait was painted by a famous artist.

examples.text: علقنا هالبورتريه بنص الصالون عشان يبين للضيوف.
examples.trans: We hung this portrait in the middle of the living room so guests can see it.

meanings.note: Used extensively to refer to preceding statements, rumors, or ongoing discussions.

examples.trans: This talk is not correct at all.

examples.text: بكفي هالحكي الفاضي وخلينا نركز بالشغل.
examples.trans: Enough of this empty talk—let's focus on the work.

meanings.note: Everyday demonstrative pronoun for feminine singular objects.

examples.trans: This girl is very smart.

examples.text: هاي الطريقة أسهل بكثير من اللي جربناها امبارح.
examples.trans: This method is much easier than the one we tried yesterday.

meanings.note: Cardinal number or used as an indefinite pronoun.

examples.trans: There is someone asking about you.

examples.text: اشتريت كتاب واحد بس من المعرض لأنه كان غالي.
examples.trans: I bought just one book from the fair because it was expensive.

meanings.note: Feminine adjective used for clarity in speech or vision.

examples.trans: The picture is not very clear.

examples.text: الشروط المكتوبة بالعقد واضحة وما بدها تفسير.
examples.trans: The terms written in the contract are clear and need no explanation.

meanings.note: Common expression indicating spatial proximity to a masculine object.

examples.trans: Put the chair and beside it the table.

examples.text: المخبز موجود عالشارع الرئيسي وجنبه صيدلية كبيرة.
examples.trans: The bakery is on the main street, and next to it is a large pharmacy.

meanings.note: Collective noun used for paper material or leaves of a tree.

examples.text: جيب لي شوية ورق أكتب عليهم.
examples.trans: Bring me some paper to write on.

examples.text: لفينا ورق دوالي اليوم الصبح للغدا مع اللبن.
examples.trans: We rolled grape leaves this morning for lunch with yogurt.

meanings.note: Used in compound numbers (e.g., twenty-one, twenty-two).

examples.trans: He is twenty-five years old.

examples.text: دفعنا سبعة وعشرين دينار حساب الغدا بالمطعم.
examples.trans: We paid twenty-seven dinars for the lunch bill at the restaurant.

meanings.note: Preposition used to indicate position or direction, attached to 'and'.

examples.text: حطيت الكتاب ع الطاولة وعلى الكرسي.
examples.trans: I put the book on the table and on the chair.

examples.text: اتفقنا عالموعد وعلى كل تفاصيل المشروع الجديد.
examples.trans: We agreed on the appointment and on all the details of the new project.

وفيه.gloss: and in it / and there is in it

meanings.en: and in it / and there is in it
meanings.note: Refers to something containing another thing, or simply 'and there is'.

examples.trans: The box is big and there are things in it.

examples.text: فتحت الدرج الصغير وفيه شوية مفاتيح قديمة.
examples.trans: I opened the small drawer, and there are a few old keys in it.

meanings.note: Used to describe a group of people holding something.

examples.trans: The kids are playing and holding each other's hands.

examples.text: الشباب واقفين عالدور وماسكين التذاكر بإيديهم.
examples.trans: The young people are standing in line holding the tickets in their hands.

meanings.note: Vocative particle used when addressing someone directly.

examples.trans: Oh Ahmed, come here.

examples.text: يا سيدي، تفضل اشرب معنا فنجان قهوة قبل ما تروح.
examples.trans: Sir, please come have a cup of coffee with us before you leave.

meanings.note: Standard noun for day, often used in expressions like 'el-yom' (today).

examples.trans: Today is a long day.

examples.text: سافرنا عالعقبة وقعدنا هناك يوم كامل عالشط.
examples.trans: We traveled to Aqaba and spent a whole day there at the beach.
